name: Dr. Afaf Saeed
paragraphs: Dr. Afaf Saeed has over 10 years of experience working in the UK's National Health Service (NHS). She completed her specialist training in General Practice and was awarded a Certificate of Completion of Training (CCT) and Membership of the Royal College of General Practitioners (MRCGP).

As a family physician, Dr. Saeed enjoys caring for patients of all ages and values the variety that general practice brings. She has experience managing a wide range of acute and chronic medical conditions and has particular interests in women's health and preventive care. She believes that the best healthcare starts with listening, understanding each patient's individual needs, and working together to achieve the best possible outcomes.

Throughout her career, Dr. Saeed has been privileged to care for patients from many different backgrounds and enjoys building lasting relationships with individuals and families. She is committed to providing compassionate, evidence-based care in a welcoming and supportive environment.
Dr. Saeed is originally from the northern areas of Pakistan. She speaks Urdu and Punjabi, and also understands Pashto.
Outside of medicine, Dr. Saeed enjoys spending time with her family and is excited to begin this new chapter in Ontario, where she looks forward to caring for the local community.

name: Dr. Sidra Saif
paragraphs: Dr. Sidra Saif is an experienced and compassionate medical professional who is committed to providing exceptional care to her patients.
After her graduation, Dr. Saif continued to pursue further specialization, leading to her attainment of the prestigious MRCGP certification.
Dr. Saif is a highly motivated individual who is always looking to enhance her knowledge and skills.
She has worked in numerous departments, including Psychiatry, ENT, Acute medicine, Accident & Emergency, Paediatrics, Obstetrics, and Gynaecology.
These experiences have not only expanded her clinical expertise but have also instilled in her the leadership capabilities necessary to excel in her field.
Looking ahead, Dr. Saif remains committed to broadening her scope of practice and enhancing her proficiency in Family Medicine.
Her goal is to offer comprehensive and holistic care to her patients at Valleyview Medical Centre, ensuring that every individual receives the highest quality of care tailored to their unique needs.

In addition to her professional accomplishments, Dr. Saif is fluent in both English and Urdu, enabling her to communicate effectively with a diverse patient population and establish strong doctor-patient relationships based on trust and understanding.

name: Dr. Abdullah Khan
paragraphs: Valleyview Medical Centre is proud to introduce Dr. Abdullah Khan, an esteemed medical professional with over 12 years of experience since his graduation.
Dr. Khan's journey in the field of medicine has taken him across borders, as he has practiced in both England and Scotland, honing his skills and gaining invaluable experience.
With a solid foundation in neurosurgery, Dr. Khan brings a unique and specialized perspective to the medical team at Valleyview Medical Centre.
His background in neurosurgery reflects not only his commitment to excellence but also his ability to handle complex medical cases with precision and expertise.

Beyond his neurosurgical prowess, Dr. Khan serves as a dedicated family physician at our medical centre. His diverse experience allows him to provide holistic and comprehensive healthcare services to patients of all ages.
The combination of his neurosurgical background and family medicine expertise makes Dr. Khan a valuable asset to our team.

name: Dr. Emmanuel Olamide Adeogun
paragraphs: Dr. Emmanuel is a highly skilled and versatile medical professional whose extensive background in healthcare demonstrates remarkable leadership capabilities.

Prior to joining Valleyview, he gained valuable experience as a General Practitioner Registrar, focusing on primary care services, and also worked as an Emergency Medicine Bank Registrar, adeptly managing urgent cases in the emergency department.

Driven by a commitment to excel, he undertook roles as a Junior Clinical Fellow in various departments, including Endocrinology and Diabetes, acute medicine, and elderly patient care, expanding his clinical expertise.
His active involvement during the Covid-19 pandemic as an emergency department Registrar further honed his skills in navigating pandemic-related challenges.

With a persistent dedication to learning, he aims to enhance his proficiency in psychiatry, pediatrics, obstetrics, and gynecology, allowing him to offer comprehensive patient care across diverse specialties.

Dr. Emmanuel's educational achievements include an M.B.B.S. degree and certifications in Minor Surgery, Joint Injection, EPALS, and ACLS, equipping him with essential skills to address multifaceted medical requirements.
Fluent in both English and Yoruba, he ensures effective communication with a diverse patient population, underscoring his commitment to delivering top-tier healthcare services.

name: Dr. Rashida Anike Agoro
paragraphs: Dr. Rashida Anike Agoro brings a specialized focus on Geriatric Medicine, Women's Health, Psychiatry, Pediatrics, and General Practice, bringing a wealth of knowledge and a commitment to comprehensive patient care.
Dr. Agoro's journey in medicine is marked by a dedication to understanding and addressing the unique healthcare needs of diverse patient populations.
Her proficiency in Geriatric Medicine ensures that elderly patients receive tailored care that respects their individual health requirements.

In the realm of Women's Health, Dr. Agoro is adept at managing a spectrum of issues, providing women with compassionate and informed healthcare solutions. Her expertise extends to Psychiatry, allowing her to navigate and support patients facing mental health challenges with empathy and understanding.
As a skilled General Practitioner, Dr. Agoro combines clinical excellence with a compassionate approach.
Her proficiency in Pediatrics underscores her ability to care for our youngest patients, ensuring their health and well-being from an early age.

What truly sets Dr. Agoro apart is her commitment to ongoing professional development. This dedication ensures that she remains at the forefront of medical advancements, offering Valleyview Medical Centre's patients the latest and most effective treatments.

name: Dr. Shehla Qadeer
paragraphs: Dr. Qadeer is a Part-time Family Physician at Valleyview Harmony with over 17 years of experience.
She has special interests in Women's Health (PAP Clinic), Diabetes Management, and Travel Advice.

name: Dr. Olajide Afolarin
role: M.B.Ch.B., MRCGP, FPHC, DUMC, CCFP | Family Physician
paragraphs: Dr. Olajide Afolarin is a highly experienced family physician with over 12 years of medical practice, specializing in emergency and urgent medical care. With a passion for delivering high-quality healthcare, Dr. Afolarin has worked extensively in both general medicine and emergency care, having held leadership roles in urgent medical setups and treatment centers across various tertiary institutions in the United Kingdom.

As an emergency physician, Dr. Afolarin has served as an Associate Specialist and in charge of prominent emergency departments in the UK, gaining invaluable experience in managing complex and urgent medical cases. His clinical expertise spans a variety of specialties, including general surgery, geriatrics, cardiology, and pediatrics.

Dr. Afolarin holds several prestigious qualifications, including the M.B.Ch.B. from OAU Ife, Nigeria, as well as memberships with the Royal College of General Practitioners (MRCGP), Diploma in Urgent Medical Care (DUMC) from Royal College of Surgeons Edinburgh, the Faculty of Prehospital Care (FPHC), and the College of Family Physicians Canada (CCFP). He has also earned certifications in ATLS, APLS, ALS, and EPLS.

Dr. Afolarin is known for his exceptional communication skills, attentiveness to patient concerns, and compassionate care. His fluency in both English and Yoruba allows him to connect with a diverse patient population.

name: Dr. Maren Preussler
paragraphs: Dr. Maren completed her medical education at the prestigious King's College London in the United Kingdom, earning both a Bachelor of Science in Human Anatomy and Biology—with a focus on advanced anatomy, surgical science, and cancer biology—and her MBBS qualification. Her training included hands-on experience in emergency medicine, general surgery, and stroke medicine.

Following this, Dr. Maren pursued specialization in family medicine, receiving extensive exposure to areas such as neurology, ENT, ophthalmology, psychiatry, and primary care. She completed her family medicine training in early 2025 through the Royal College of General Practitioners (UK) and has since practiced as a fully qualified GP in the UK.

Dedicated to continuous learning and innovation in healthcare, Dr. Maren remains actively engaged in current medical advancements to ensure her patients receive the most effective and up-to-date care. Her current clinical interests include women's health and minor procedures.

name: Dr. Olugbenga Oluwafunmilade Ajayi
paragraphs: Dr. Olugbenga Ajayi is a warm, attentive, and highly skilled family physician dedicated to providing personalized, compassionate care for individuals and families across all stages of life. With a broad international background in medicine, Dr. Ajayi brings over a decade of experience from healthcare systems in the United Kingdom and Nigeria.

Dr. Ajayi takes time to listen carefully to his patients, ensuring their concerns are heard, understood, and thoughtfully addressed. Whether managing a chronic condition, addressing a new symptom, or focusing on preventive health, Dr. Ajayi partners with patients to create treatment plans that reflect their individual needs and goals.

With special interests in lifestyle and preventive medicine, chronic disease management, and minor procedures, Dr. Ajayi offers comprehensive family care rooted in clinical excellence. His experience spans urgent care, emergency medicine, pediatrics, geriatrics, cardiology, and neurology.

He holds a Medical Degree (M.B.Ch.B.) from Obafemi Awolowo University, Nigeria, is a Member of the Royal College of General Practitioners (UK), and a certified member of the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CCFP).
Dr. Ajayi is fluent in English and Yoruba, and is proud to serve patients from diverse cultural backgrounds.

name: Dr. Kehinde Hazzan
paragraphs: Dr. Kehinde Hazzan is an experienced and compassionate General Practitioner dedicated to providing high-quality, patient-centred care. With extensive clinical experience across the United Kingdom and Nigeria, he is known for his thorough assessments, clear communication style, and ability to build strong, trusting relationships with his patients.

Dr. Hazzan completed his MBChB in Medicine at Obafemi Awolowo University in Nigeria and later pursued GP Specialist Training in Northallerton, earning his Certificate of Completion of Training in 2022. He is a proud member of the Royal College of General Practitioners (RCGP).

Over the years, Dr. Hazzan has worked in multiple clinical settings including emergency care, paediatrics, general medicine, and community family practice. He has served in numerous GP roles across the UK—both as a salaried physician and as a locum—where he developed a reputation for accurate diagnosis, effective treatment planning, and a gentle, patient-focused approach to care.
His clinical strengths include preventive medicine, chronic disease management, elderly care, paediatric care, specialist referrals, and comprehensive physical examinations.

name: Dr. Olalekan Adekeye
paragraphs: Dr. Olalekan Adekeye is a skilled and highly dedicated General Practitioner with a strong background in diverse clinical settings, including general practice, emergency medicine, paediatrics, and acute care. With a reputation for delivering safe, reliable, and compassionate patient care, Dr. Adekeye provides comprehensive medical services tailored to each patient's individual needs.

He completed his MBChB in Medicine at Obafemi Awolowo University and later achieved his MRCGP after completing GP Specialty Training in Northallerton, United Kingdom. His training and experience span multiple hospitals and GP practices across the UK.

Dr. Adekeye has held several clinical roles, including Locum GP work, serving as a Salaried GP, and completing registrar rotations in paediatrics, emergency medicine, general medicine, and primary care. He is particularly skilled in managing both acute and chronic illnesses, conducting detailed physical examinations, reviewing diagnostics, and coordinating care with multidisciplinary teams.

Known for his clear communication, gentle bedside manner, and patient-first philosophy, Dr. Adekeye takes pride in creating a comfortable environment where patients feel supported, respected, and well-informed about their health.
